name: Batch
description: Performs multiple create, update, delete, or query operations on QuickBooks Online entities in a single request to reduce network roundtrips and improve throughput.

operations.name: Sample batch request
operations.description: Submits a batch of BatchItemRequest objects (each performing a create, update, delete, or query operation) in a single authenticated request. Maximum 30 payloads per request, 40 requests per minute per realmID, and up to 1000 objects returned in a response. Execution order is not guaranteed and items are processed independently.

pathParams.name: realmID
pathParams.description: The company ID (realm ID) for the QuickBooks Online company against which the batch operations are executed.

requestBody.description: The request includes BatchItemRequest objects, each performing a create, update, delete, or query operation.

attributes.name: BatchItemRequest
attributes.description: A wrapper around all request objects for this batch operation.

operations.note: A batch request is authenticated once, and that single authentication applies to all BatchItemRequest objects. BatchItemRequest objects are treated independently; one object cannot depend on another within the same batch operation. Execution order of BatchItemRequest objects should not be assumed.
